battle.name: 西班牙內戰
battle.theater: 伊比利亞半島與西地中海
battle.brief: 1936年7月17日西班牙內戰爆發，叛軍與人民陣線政府對抗，德義與蘇聯分別武裝干涉。卡面這門線膛前裝野戰砲，是十九世紀德國的技術產物，1936年已退居軍械庫與固定砲位；但正是它開出的線膛路徑，讓砲兵第一次能在射程上壓過步兵，決定了整場戰爭以火力密度與縱深為核心的樣貌。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 西班牙內戰於1936年7月17日開打，實質是第二共和國的人民陣線政府與以佛朗哥為首的國民軍之間的一場全面內戰。共和派一方由總統曼努埃爾・阿薩尼亞主持國政，先後由卡薩雷斯・基羅加、何塞・希拉爾、拉戈・卡瓦列羅、胡安・內格林出任總理；軍方以國防委員會與總參謀長比森特・羅霍為核心，1936年9月改編為人民陸軍，並得到當地產業工人的武裝支援。陣線內含西班牙共產黨、社會黨、無政府主義者總工會CNT-FAI、聯合總工會UGT、馬克思主義統一工人黨POUM，以及巴斯克、加泰隆尼亞與阿拉貢的地方武裝。國民軍一方以叛變軍官為骨幹：7月17日摩洛哥梅利利亞首先起事，7月21日佛朗哥在薩拉曼卡被推為全軍總指揮，北方由埃米利奧・莫拉、中部由卡洛斯・德・塞維亞、南部由貢薩洛・德亞諾分別發動，布哥斯另設國防委員會與後來的總政府；政治上以長槍黨與何塞・德里維拉為核心，聯合保皇黨與卡洛斯派。外來援助同樣是編制的一部分：德國派出兀鷹軍團，1936年11月的高峰兵力約一萬二千人，全役參與的德軍總數近一萬九千人；義大利派出志願軍團CTV與航空兵團，在西班牙境內同時駐紮約五萬人，全役輪替上陣逾七萬五千人；葡萄牙以「維里亞修斯團」名義派出至多兩萬名志願軍，並承擔德義輸華的中轉港。共和派的外部支柱是蘇聯與墨西哥：蘇聯秘密交付八百零六架飛機、三百六十二輛坦克與一千五百五十五門火砲，留在西班牙的蘇聯軍事人員不超過七百人；墨西哥提供二百萬美元、兩萬支步槍、二十八萬發子彈與八門火砲；國際縱隊先後有約三萬二千人自五十餘國來到共和派一邊。英法推動的不干涉協議，與1937年2月22日國聯禁止外國志願兵參戰的決議，使雙方的外部補給始終不對等。
countriesEn: Spain's civil war broke out on 17 July 1936; in substance it was a full-scale civil war between the Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic and Francisco Franco's Nationalist army. On the Republican side the state was headed by President Manuel Azaña, with Casares Quiroga, José Giral, Largo Caballero and Juan Negrín serving in turn as prime minister; the military command centred on the Junta de Defensa Nacional and on Commander-in-Chief Vicente Rojo, the armed forces being reorganised in September 1936 into the People's Army, with the backing of armed industrial workers. The Front itself embraced the Spanish Communist Party, the Socialist Party, the anarcho-syndicalist CNT-FAI, the UGT, the POUM, and the local militias of the Basque country, Catalonia and Aragon. The Nationalist side rested on rebel officers: the rising began at Melilla in Morocco on 17 July; on 21 July Franco was named overall commander at Salamanca; in the north Emilio Mola, in the centre Carlos de Sevilla and in the south Gonzalo Queipo de Llano each launched their own offensive, while Burgos housed the Junta de Defensa Nacional and, later, the general government. Politically the movement was led by the Falange and José Antonio Primo de Rivera, allied with the monarchists of Antonio Goicoechea and the Carlists. Foreign contingents were equally part of the order of battle: Germany sent the Condor Legion, whose strength peaked at about 12,000 men in November 1936 and whose total participation approached 19,000; Italy deployed the Corpo Truppe Volontarie and its aviation, with roughly 50,000 men in Spain at any time and more than 75,000 Italian soldiers served in rotation; Portugal supplied up to 20,000 volunteers in the Viriatos legion and trans-shipped German and Italian matériel through its ports. The Republic's external props were the Soviet Union and Mexico: Moscow secretly delivered 806 aircraft, 362 tanks and 1,555 guns, while Soviet military personnel in Spain never exceeded 700; Mexico provided two million dollars, 20,000 rifles, 280,000 rounds and eight artillery pieces; and some 32,000 men from more than fifty countries came to the Republican side in the International Brigades. The Anglo-French Non-Intervention Agreement and the League of Nations resolution of 22 February 1937 forbidding foreign volunteers meant that external supply on the two sides was never equal.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的人分處兩個指揮系統。國民軍方面，佛朗哥在薩拉曼卡接掌全軍後，以摩洛哥的非洲軍團作為突擊矛頭，並在德義參謀與兀鷹軍團的協助下確立攻勢節奏；北方指揮埃米利奧・莫拉於1937年6月3日因空難身亡，接任者是菲德爾・達維拉；貢薩洛・德亞諾長期坐鎮塞維亞，掌握南部補給；原定負責奪取薩拉戈薩的米格爾・卡瓦內利亞斯在起事中被共和派拘押，隨後倒向共和一方，於埃布羅河戰役中指揮第五軍取得局部攻勢。共和派方面，總統阿薩尼亞主持國政但缺乏軍權；拉戈・卡瓦列羅以社會黨領袖身分出任總理，1937年5月內閣垮台後由胡安・內格林接任，內格林主張繼續抵抗並把國家置於黨爭之上；國防委員會主席何塞・米亞哈與總參謀長比森特・羅霍分別掌握政令與兵權，第五軍司令卡瓦內利亞斯、參謀長胡安・莫德斯托與巴斯克地區的何塞・安東尼奧・阿吉雷都是關鍵人物。共產黨方面有何塞・狄亞斯與海軍上將佩德羅・切阿拉，無政府主義者有布恩阿文圖拉・杜魯蒂，其縱隊在巴塞隆那外圍作戰時陣亡；馬克思主義統一工人黨的領袖安德烈斯・尼恩在1937年被殺。國際縱隊那邊有安德烈・馬爾羅與法國飛行員、參與民兵行列的喬治・歐威爾，以及蘇聯派駐的維托里奧・維達利；飛行員方面有共和國空軍總司令卡洛斯・德爾・佩迪羅、帕布羅・拉莫斯・布萊克、杜桑・布拉什科維奇與費利克斯・別爾梅霍，德方有胡戈・施佩累、沃爾夫拉姆・馮・里希特霍芬、莫里茨・費爾默與坎特・曼海姆，義方則有費魯吉奧・比薩利。
peopleEn: The men who decided this war belonged to two command systems. On the Nationalist side, once he took overall command at Salamanca, Franco used the African Legion from Morocco as the spearhead of his offensives and set the rhythm of his advances with the help of German and Italian staff officers and of the Condor Legion; the northern commander Emilio Mola was killed in an air crash on 3 June 1937 and was succeeded by Fidel Dávila; Gonzalo Queipo de Llano sat in Seville for the whole war, holding the southern supply lines; Miguel Cabanellas, originally assigned to seize Zaragoza for the rising, was arrested by the Republicans and afterwards came over to their side, commanding the Fifth Army to local success in the Ebro battle. On the Republican side, President Azaña headed the state but held no real military power; Largo Caballero, the Socialist leader, served as prime minister, and after his cabinet collapsed in May 1937 Juan Negrín took over, insisting on continued resistance and putting the state above party quarrels; José Miaja as head of the Junta de Defensa and Commander-in-Chief Vicente Rojo held the governmental and military levers respectively, while Cabanellas of the Fifth Army, chief of staff Juan Modesto and the Basque leader José Antonio Aguirre were all men who mattered. On the communist side there were José Díaz and the naval officer Pedro Čeradnik; among the anarchists Buenaventura Durruti, whose columns fought outside Barcelona and who was killed there in July 1936; and Andrés Nin, leader of the POUM, murdered in 1937. On the International Brigades side stood André Malraux with the French pilots, George Orwell who served in a militia column, and Vittorio Vidali, the Soviet liaison. Among the aviators were Carlos del Pedero, the Republican air force commander, Pablo Ramos Bradley, Dušan Brašković and Félix Bermejo; on the German side Hugo Sperrle, Wolfram von Richthofen, Moritz Ferrer and Cantos; on the Italian side, Ferruccio Biseo.
kits: 卡面這門線膛砲代表的是1850年前後德國的技術路徑：把炮膛內壁刻上螺旋膛線，讓同樣藥量的火藥在膛內旋轉一周，換來更平直的彈道與更遠的射程。西班牙軍械庫裡正存著這條路徑的末代製品，普魯士克虜伯的8公分與9公分砲（1870與1871年型）、法國施奈德的12公分砲（1870年型），以及數量更多的十九世紀前裝銅砲。它們到1936年七月已屬過時：射程不及同口徑後膛砲，操作緩慢，發射時的後座與硝煙在神經質的連線中極難駕馭。但共和派民兵與國民派的「團」在頭幾個月確實把這些老砲從軍械庫拉出來，充當固定砲位、山區砲兵、訓練學校與守備武器，其中一部分是拴在砲車上、用騾馬拖曳的行軍型野戰砲，連火藥與曳光彈都要從前線後方一箱箱補上。真正接替它們位置的，是二十世紀的曲射砲：德製10.5公分野戰榴砲、15公分重榴砲、義製81公分迫擊砲與120公分迫擊砲、蘇聯的76公分師屬砲與122、152公分榴砲，以及共和軍手中那批被士兵稱為「貝爾敦砲」的105公分野戰榴砲，1937年4月在瓜達拉哈拉方向繳獲，共六門，拖著騾馬上戰線，後來在埃布羅河戰役打到最後一天仍在發射。砲兵之外，雙方還有坦克與飛機：蘇聯T-26輕型坦克與BT-5騎兵坦克、國民軍的德製三號坦克與義大利L3/35輕戰車、仿製FT-17的T-5裝甲車；空軍方面是德方的Bf 109與Ju 52/3m、義方的CR.32與SM.79、蘇聯的I-15與I-16、波蘭「科修斯科」中隊的PZL戰鬥機，以及法製德沃坦D.510驅逐機。輕武器以7.92公釐毛瑟步槍、6.35公釐「波洛」卡賓槍與莫辛-那伽特步槍為主，機槍有路易斯、維克斯與義大利布萊達M37。海上，義大利的水上轟炸機與小型突擊艇、德國U-33與U-34潛艇重創共和國艦隊，國民軍自此掌握地中海制海權。運輸方面，砲兵仍靠騾馬與卡車，裝甲列車與驛站網構成戰區骨架，燃料則成為共和派最難解的問題。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun on the card stands for the German technical path of around 1850: cutting a spiral groove into the bore so that the same charge of powder, spinning once inside the barrel, buys a straighter trajectory and longer range. The Spanish arsenals still held the last products of that line, Krupp's 8 cm and 9 cm guns of the 1870 and 1871 patterns, Schneider's 12 cm gun of the 1870 pattern, and a larger number of nineteenth-century bronze muzzle-loaders. By July 1936 they were already obsolete: shorter in range than breech-loaders of the same calibre, slow to handle, and their recoil and smoke were extremely hard to control on a nervous gun line. Yet in the first months Republican militias and the Nationalist regiments did haul these old guns out of the depots, using them as fixed batteries, mountain artillery, training pieces and garrison weapons; some were travel guns still bolted to their limbers and hauled by mules, with ammunition and primers passed up by hand from the rear. What really displaced them was twentieth-century high-angle artillery: the German 10.5 cm field howitzer, the 15 cm heavy howitzer, the Italian 81 cm and 120 cm mortars, the Soviet 76 cm divisional gun and 122 and 152 cm howitzers, and above all the batch of 105 cm field howitzers the Republican troops called the Berdun guns, six of them captured in the Guadalajara direction in April 1937, dragged up on mules and still firing on the last day of the Ebro battle. Beyond the guns there were tanks and aircraft: Soviet T-26 light tanks and BT-5 cavalry tanks, German Panzer III and Italian L3/35 light tanks on the Nationalist side, T-5 armoured cars copied from the FT-17; in the air, the German Bf 109 and Ju 52/3m, the Italian CR.32 and SM.79, the Soviet I-15 and I-16, the PZL fighters of the Polish Kosciuszko squadron, and the French Dewoitine D.510. Small arms were dominated by the 7.92 mm Mauser rifle, the 6.35 mm bolo carbine and the Mosin-Nagant, with Lewis, Vickers and Italian Breda M37 machine guns. At sea, Italian seaplanes and midget torpedo boats and the German U-33 and U-34 submarines wrecked the Republican fleet, leaving the Nationalists in control of the Mediterranean. On the logistics side, artillery still moved on mules and lorries, armoured trains and the railway network formed the skeleton of the front, and fuel became the Republic's most intractable problem.
tactics: 國民軍的打法是一套以公路為骨架的機動作戰：先以摩洛哥非洲軍團在安達盧西亞登陸，擊破兵力空虛的共和派守軍，再以縱隊沿塞維亞—科爾多瓦—瓜迪克斯的公路軸線北進；砲兵與戰車沿公路展開，兀鷹軍團的Bf 109與Ju 52/3m在縱隊上方提供近距空中支援，用俯衝與水平投彈覆蓋步兵的接觸線；到了1938年，國民軍以阿拉貢攻勢連續突破，形成從地中海向瓦倫西亞與巴塞隆那推進的態勢，並用制海權切斷共和派南北兩區的聯繫。共和派則以縱隊對付縱隊：1936年11月從瓦倫西亞出發的「鐵柱」冒雨急行三百餘公里馳援馬德里，擋住南線的非洲軍團；民兵改組為人民陸軍後，1937年的布魯內特攻勢、1938年1月收復托魯爾、7月帕尼亞山的第五軍反攻，都是以步兵密集隊形配合迫擊砲與工兵爆破，在方圓不到一百公里內反覆拉鋸。埃布羅河戰役最能說明雙方戰術差異：共和軍以梯形陣地、縱深反斜面與大量105公分「貝爾敦砲」在四百餘公里的戰線上構築阻擊帶，國民軍則以密集縱隊反覆強攻，每每在渡口與橋頭堡得手，卻總在下一個縱深地帶被擋住。城市戰是另一個重點，馬德里與巴塞隆那的街巷防禦、地下戰壘與定向爆破，和鄉間的縱隊決戰同時進行。補給線上，國民軍靠德義船運汽車與槍砲從維戈、塞維亞、畢爾巴鄂上岸，並取得德克薩斯石油運來的數百萬噸汽油；共和派靠巴塞隆那、瓦倫西亞與阿利坎特的港口，以及越過比利牛斯山走私小船的隊伍，燃料短缺直接壓縮了它的機動時間。
tacticsEn: The Nationalist method was a motorised war built on the road network. The African Legion landed in Andalusia from Morocco, broke a Republican army thin on numbers, and then drove north in columns along the Seville-Cordoba-Guadix axis; artillery and tanks unlimbered beside the roads while the Condor Legion's Bf 109s and Ju 52/3m flew close support overhead, laying down dive and level attacks on the infantry contact line. By 1938 the Aragon offensive had broken through again and again, producing a drive from the Mediterranean toward Valencia and Barcelona, while command of the sea cut the Republic's northern and southern zones apart from one another. The Republicans answered columns with columns: the Iron Columns set out from Valencia in November 1936 and, marching in the rain, covered more than three hundred kilometres to reinforce Madrid, blocking the African Legion on the southern approach; once the militias had been converted into the People's Army, the Brunete offensive of 1937, the recapture of Teruel in January 1938 and the Fifth Army's counter-attack in the Sierra de Paños in July were all infantry massing supported by mortars and engineer demolition, fought back and forth over ground of less than a hundred kilometres. The Ebro battle best shows the difference in doctrine: the Republicans built a blocking zone of echeloned positions, reverse-slope defences and large numbers of 105 cm Berdun howitzers along a front of more than four hundred kilometres, while the Nationalists attacked in dense columns, winning the river crossings and bridgeheads only to be halted at the next depth belt. Urban combat was a second front, with street defences, underground works and directed demolition in Madrid and Barcelona running alongside column battles in the open country. On the supply line the Nationalists landed vehicles and guns from Vigo, Seville and Bilbao in German and Italian ships and drew millions of tons of gasoline from Texas oil; the Republic relied on the ports of Barcelona, Valencia and Alicante and on small boats smuggling the Pyrenees, and its shortage of fuel directly compressed the time available for manoeuvre.
data: 數字可以大致勾勒出這場戰爭的規模。時間上，1936年7月17日起事至1939年4月1日佛朗哥宣布勝利，歷時約兩年八個半月。1936年7月的西班牙本土軍只有八個步兵師、一個騎兵師與三個山地旅，非洲軍團則有兩個裝備完整的步兵師；叛軍計畫牽涉一萬五千一百六十七名現役軍官，警察約四成、突擊衛隊約三成、空軍約四分之一倒向國民軍；海軍編制為三艘巡洋艦、十五艘驅逐艦、九艘潛艇與兩艘戰艦。蘇聯交付共和派八百零六架飛機、三百六十二輛坦克與一千五百五十五門火砲，付款方式是西班牙央行的黃金，依記載有五百一十噸直接運往蘇聯保管，另有一百七十六噸寄存法國。墨西哥的援助為二百萬美元、兩萬支步槍、二十八萬發子彈與八門火砲。義大利自1936年9月起提供六十八架飛機，境內駐軍約五萬人，全役七萬五千人次上陣；德國的「魔火」行動以十一架Ju 52、六架He 51與八十五名武裝黨衛軍護送外籍兵團，1936年9月的「奧托」行動再送來二十四輛一號坦克與九十二架新機，兀鷹軍團高峰兵力約一萬二千人，全役德軍參與者近一萬九千人；葡萄牙志願軍至多兩萬人。國際縱隊全役約三萬二千人，其中林肯營規模五六百人，瓜達拉哈拉一役折損逾半。作戰層面，瓜達拉哈拉之戰雙方傷亡各逾六千人；布魯內特之戰共和軍損失約兩萬五千人與百餘架飛機；桑坦德攻勢中共和軍被殲滅與俘虜六萬餘人；埃布羅河戰役歷時三個月，共和軍損失約六萬人。共和派控制區內的巴斯克鋼鐵與軍火廠在佔領後被改組為軍工生產體系，晝夜不停生產砲彈與鋼材。
dataEn: The figures roughly sketch the scale of the war. In time, the rising of 17 July 1936 to Franco's victory proclamation on 1 April 1939 ran about two years and eight and a half months. In July 1936 the Spanish mainland army had only eight infantry divisions, one cavalry division and three mountain brigades, while the African Colonial Army fielded two fully equipped infantry divisions; the rebel plan implicated 15,167 serving officers, about 40 per cent of the police, 30 per cent of the Assault Guards and 25 per cent of the air force; the navy comprised three cruisers, fifteen destroyers, nine submarines and two battleships. The Soviet Union delivered 806 aircraft, 362 tanks and 1,555 guns to the Republic, paid for in the central bank's gold: by the record 510 tons went straight to the Soviet Union for safekeeping and a further 176 tons were deposited in France. Mexico's aid came to two million dollars, 20,000 rifles, 280,000 rounds and eight artillery pieces. Italy supplied sixty-eight aircraft from September 1936, kept about 50,000 men in Spain and put more than 75,000 men through the campaign in rotation; Germany's Magic Fire operation carried eleven Ju 52s, six He 51s and eighty-five Waffen-SS men to convoy the foreign legion, and the Otto operation of September 1936 added twenty-four Type I tanks and ninety-two new aircraft, the Condor Legion peaking at about 12,000 men and German participation approaching 19,000 over the whole war; Portugal sent up to 20,000 volunteers. The International Brigades numbered about 32,000 men in all, the Lincoln Battalion among them numbering five or six hundred and losing more than half of its strength at Guadalajara. At the level of operations, casualties on both sides at Guadalajara exceeded 6,000; the Republic lost about 25,000 men and more than a hundred aircraft at Brunete; at Santander more than 60,000 Republicans were destroyed or captured; the Ebro battle lasted three months and cost the Republican side about 60,000 men. The steelworks and arsenals of the Basque country, inside the Republican zone, were reorganised after the occupation into a war production system running day and night on shells and steel.
cause: 戰爭不是單一事件引爆的。第一共和國的崩潰、波旁王朝復辟與1923年至1930年的獨裁，把西班牙變成一個軍人與地主緊密結盟、而工人農民與城市中產被排除在政治之外的國家；土地改革、教會財產歸還與自治條例的廢除，又在1933年至1935年把右翼推上街頭。1936年2月人民陣線在選舉中取得二百六十七席，逼近三分之二，總理府周邊的暗殺隨之而來：右翼議員何塞・卡爾沃・索特洛被左翼警衛人員殺害，激發軍方以「西班牙軍事聯盟」為名的密謀；桑胡爾霍、胡安・貝格韋德爾與莫拉在境外策劃，擬以軍隊起事推翻政府。關鍵在於7月17日當天，起事只在部分駐軍與城市得手，摩洛哥梅利利亞、薩拉戈薩、塞維亞與科爾多瓦相繼易手，但馬德里、巴塞隆那、瓦倫西亞、畢爾巴鄂與主要海軍基地仍在政府手上，政變於是變成雙方都沒有退路的全面內戰。共和政府的處置也加速了局面：猶豫數日才發槍給民眾，軍火庫的鑰匙與廠房的開關在街頭易手，馬德里的蒙塔尼亞兵營被民兵攻下，非洲軍團則在幾天內由海外空運與海運投入西班牙本土，甫一接觸就因缺油缺彈而陷入苦戰。國際層面，義大利在阿比西尼亞戰爭中已試過用兵，德國在萊茵蘭重新武裝，兩國都願意把西班牙當成演武場；而英法在法國總理勃魯姆主持下推行的不干涉協議，則從一開始就堵死了共和派的外援。
causeEn: The war was not triggered by a single event. The collapse of the First Republic, the Bourbon restoration and seven years of dictatorship from 1923 to 1930 turned Spain into a country where officers and landowners were closely allied while workers, peasants and the urban middle class were excluded from politics; the land reform, the restitution of church property and the repeal of the autonomy statutes pushed the right into the streets in 1933 and 1935. In the election of February 1936 the Popular Front took 267 seats, close to two thirds, and the killings around the ministry followed: the right-wing deputy José Calvo Sotelo was murdered by left-wing Assault Guard officers, which hardened a conspiracy in the army under the name of the Spanish Military Union; Sanjurjo, Juan Beigbeder and Mola planned from abroad to bring the army into a rising against the government. What mattered was that on 17 July the rising succeeded only in some garrisons and cities: Melilla in Morocco, Zaragoza, Seville and Cordoba changed hands, but Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Bilbao and the principal naval bases stayed in government hands, and the coup became a general civil war from which neither side could withdraw. The Republic's own handling of it accelerated the collapse: guns were handed out to the people only after several days of hesitation, the keys to the arsenals and the switches of the factories changed hands in the streets, the Montaña barracks in Madrid were stormed by the militias, and the African Legion was airlifted and shipped into peninsular Spain within days, where it was starved of fuel and ammunition even as it fought. At the international level, Italy had already campaigned in Abyssinia, Germany had rearmed the Rhineland, and both were willing to use Spain as a proving ground; while the non-intervention policy pursued under the French premier Blum from the outset closed off any foreign supply to the Republic.
impact: 西班牙內戰是第二次世界大戰前最大的一次代理戰與軍事實驗。兀鷹軍團把空軍與地面部隊綁在一起的運作方式，用Bf 109護航、用Ju 52/3m做近距支援與補給、用俯衝與水平轟炸覆蓋步兵接觸線、用空運把整支非洲軍團從摩洛哥搬進安達盧西亞，在三年裡被反覆磨練，兩年之後的波蘭戰役幾乎照搬這套方法；1937年4月格爾尼卡的轟炸更被視為第一次對不設防城市的地毯式轟炸。蘇聯則在T-26與BT坦克被德義戰車與空軍打得筋疲力盡的實況中，體會到自造坦克的防禦、坦克與步兵的配合，以及高速戰鬥機與俯衝攻擊機之間的分工，回國後催生了新的裝甲理論與新型戰機，同一批經驗也讓德國加速替換一號坦克。政治層面，這場戰爭證明了國際聯盟的集體安全機制無力阻止兩大陣營在第三國開火，武器禁運與不干涉協議在德意與蘇聯面前形同廢紙，歐洲各國的左右陣營因此提前分裂成日後的兩個營壘。西班牙本身付出的代價是另一種：共和派在佔領區推行集體化，工會武裝與政黨之間的裂痕始終無法彌合，1937年5月巴塞隆那的街頭衝突之後，POUM被定性，第五團被解散，國際縱隊的指揮權被全面收走。戰後的佛朗哥西班牙維持近四十年的獨裁，直到1975年他去世才開始松動；今日西班牙加入北約與歐盟的歷程，仍是這場戰爭留下的長尾。
impactEn: The Spanish civil war was the largest proxy war and military experiment before the Second World War. The Condor Legion's way of binding air power to the ground, escorting with Bf 109s, providing close support and resupply with Ju 52/3m, covering the infantry contact line with dive and level bombing, and airlifting an entire African Legion from Morocco into Andalusia, was drilled repeatedly over three years and largely copied two years later in Poland; the bombing of Guernica in April 1937 is remembered as the first carpet bombing of an undefended town. The Soviet Union, watching its T-26 and BT tanks ground down by German and Italian armour and aircraft, learned the need for its own armoured design, for tank-infantry cooperation, and for a division of labour between fast fighters and dive bombers; the same lessons pushed Germany into retiring its first tank designs. Politically the war showed that the League of Nations' collective security system could not stop the two great blocs firing at each other on a third country's soil: the arms embargo and the non-intervention agreement were worth nothing against Germany, Italy and the Soviet Union, and Europe's left and right camps split early into the two blocs they would later become. Spain paid a different price. Collectivisation was carried out in the Republican zone, the rift between armed unions and parties was never closed, and after the street fighting of May 1937 in Barcelona the POUM was branded, the Fifth Regiment was dissolved and the command of the International Brigades was taken over wholesale. Franco's Spain then held out under dictatorship for nearly forty years, loosening only after his death in 1975; the long tail of the war still shapes Spain's later path into NATO and the European Community.
result: 1939年1月26日巴塞隆那淪陷，2月27日英法先後承認佛朗哥政權，3月28日馬德里守軍在連續轟炸與巷戰之後放下武器，4月1日佛朗哥在全國宣布戰爭結束，共和軍主力部隊在崩解中解體，少數人退入法國或墨西哥；另有數千名國際縱隊志願者，早已於1938年9月依國聯要求解散回國。結果是國民軍完勝：它掌握了從北非到法國邊界的整條補給線，握有制空權與制海權，也在三年裡把一支紀律鬆散、政治分裂的隊伍鍛造成能持續作戰的軍隊；而共和派輸在彈藥、燃料與外援的算術上，也輸在始終無法建立跨黨派的統一指揮。軍事上，兩軍的經驗都被帶進了四年後的大戰：共和派倖存者一部分組成維希法國的西班牙支隊與法國遠征軍，國民軍老兵組成「藍色師」隨德國進攻蘇聯，蘇聯則帶回了大量慘痛教訓。最後，這場戰爭在西班牙留下的不是兩種政策的比較，而是一代人的撕裂記憶。
resultEn: Barcelona fell on 26 January 1939; Britain and France recognised the Franco government on 27 February; on 28 March the defenders of Madrid laid down their arms after months of bombing and street fighting; on 1 April Franco proclaimed the war over throughout the country, the main body of the Republican army disintegrating as it dissolved, a few men reaching France or Mexico. The International Brigades, several thousand strong, had already been disbanded and sent home in September 1938 at the League of Nations' request. The Nationalists won outright. They held the entire supply line from North Africa to the French frontier, commanded both the air and the sea, and over three years turned a loose, politically divided force into an army capable of sustained operations. The Republic was defeated by the arithmetic of ammunition, fuel and foreign aid, and by its inability ever to build a unified command across the parties. Militarily, the experience of both sides was carried into the war that came four years later: Republican survivors formed part of the Spanish formations in Vichy France and the French expeditionary corps, while Nationalist veterans formed the Blue Division and went east with Germany against the Soviet Union, which in turn drew a bitter harvest of lessons from Spain. In the end, what the war left in Spain was not a comparison between two policies but the divided memory of a generation.
